blocks.text: Racerback Design: Many people will encounter the situation that the bra does not fix the chest when wearing a sports bra. In order to solve this problem, we designed the racerback. Racerback design provides more coverage for your back to provide sufficient support for women who love sports, you can enjoy sports. Built-in Padding: We designed removable padding in the chest. There are two benefits, the first is to protect your chest, to avoid friction between the chest and clothing. The second is to provide some support for your chest, which is not only beneficial to your sports, but also can shape your chest. Breathable Material: As a sports apparel, what is the most important thing? Yes, it is breathable. In order to meet the demand of sports enthusiasts as much as possible, we use skin-friendly breathable material. This can provide you with a comfortable wearing experience, and make you focus more on sports. Packs Design: As a sports-loving woman, you can't just have a sports bra, so we designed a packs design. Compared to a single unit, pack design are more preferential. Also, we provide excellent after-sales service, if you have any product problems, please contact us in time! More Occassions: The sports bra has a very wide range of occasions: you can wear it to exercise, to run, to do yoga. You can go with it according to your preference. In addition, we provide different colors, you can pair it with other clothing according to your preferences.
